description: Free appointment slots for one bookable service variant at one clinic, up to 14 days ahead. Each slot carries a FHIR Slot resource and a bookingUrl where the PATIENT completes the booking themselves on the web (this server never books).

clinic_slug.description: The clinic slug from search_clinics (the URL segment, e.g. "mickes-klinik-lund").

from_date.description: Window start (YYYY-MM-DD, clinic runs Europe/Stockholm). Defaults to today.

service_variant_id.description: A bookable service variant id from list_clinic_services.

name: get_available_slots
title: Get available slots
